description_expanded: OverviewNewly Renovated - Community Pool, Tennis - Public Beach - 2 Minute Walk `Take it Wheezy`The SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Beach Access – Just steps from the sand! 8 Amenity Bands – Exclusive community perks! Two Tennis Courts – Challenge friends & family to a match! Two Community Pools – One pool heated seasonally for year-round enjoyment! Professionally Managed – 24/7 service for a seamless stay! Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected during your vacation! Keurig Coffee Maker – Start your mornings right! General Parking - 2 Passes Provided – Hassle-free parking for guests!Welcome to Take it WheezyLocated in Seagrove Beach at the Beachside Villas, 'Take it Wheezy' is a stunning vacation rental that has recently undergone complete renovation. With modern furnishings and updated appliances, this vacation home is sure to make guests feel right at home. The rental can accommodate up to 8 guests, making it perfect for families or groups of friends looking to escape to the beach.The property features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, ensuring that guests have plenty of room to relax and unwind. The bedrooms are beautifully decorated with coastal-inspired decor, creating a relaxing and inviting atmosphere. The bathrooms have been updated with new fixtures and fittings, providing you with all the comforts of home.One of the highlights of 'Take it Wheezy' is the community amenities that you have access to. The community pool is perfect for those looking to cool off on a hot day, while the tennis courts provide an excellent opportunity to get active and enjoy a game of tennis.Seagrove Beach is a beautiful location, known for its stunning beaches and laid-back atmosphere. When staying at 'Take it Wheezy' you will be just a short walk away from the beach, allowing them to soak up the sun, swim in the clear waters, or take a stroll along the shoreline. The surrounding area is also home to a variety of local attractions, including shopping, dining, and entertainment options.Overall, 'Take it Wheezy' is an excellent vacation rental that offers everything you need for an unforgettable beach vacation. With its updated amenities, beautiful decor, and prime location, it's the perfect choice for anyone looking to escape to Seagrove Beach. This property offers 8 amenity bands. Children under 12 do not need a band. Guests will be charged $50.00 for lost amenity bands.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*** Wireless Internet access* Parking for 2 cars**CALLL FOR SNOWBIRD PRICING!**SLEEPING ARRAGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom: King sized bedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen sized bedGuest Bedroom 2: Two full sized bedsAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back. Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
